# PREFIX-987 — Exact positive named-source quotient for four-phase residual observers

Date: 2026-11-21 (Asia/Shanghai)
Status: AUTHOR_ANALYTIC_PROOF / EXACT_INTEGER_CHECKED / NOT_REVIEWED
Predecessor: PREFIX-986, four-phase eight-return/18-move finite dichotomy.
Frozen science: awdawmip/enterprise-math@f42f2906d77f24085c123f3ccfe9667d41caa96d:p000_reality_foundation.json
Scope: **auxiliary signed-source bit-flip observer**, with a fixed four-residual word; this note does not identify the observer with native Heartbeat X6 dynamics.

## Problem and definitions

Earlier PREFIX-986 preserves Boolean cycle existence but does not supply a positive weighted path carrier. This note solves the precise **locally source-factorized** subproblem, retaining complete named-source future-word observability before quotienting.

Fix p>=3 and a four-stage nonzero residual word w=(c0,c1,c2,c3).
At phase q a named source a=(q,i,j,s) obeys
c_q=2^i-s*2^j, 0<=i<p, 1<=j<p, s in {+1,-1}.
It is legal at odd input x iff bit_j(x)=(1-s)/2, and flips bit j.
Let U be the union of its nonzero source ports and m=|U|<=8 by the proven source-mask classification. The exact active state is (q,b) in Z/4 x {0,1}^U. Every unused higher bit is an unchanged spectator. Let Sigma be the **named** alphabet of all such (q,i,j,s) across the fixed word. The transition delta((q,b),a) is defined only for the matching phase and legal bit; its target is (q+1 mod 4,b xor e_j). For a word alpha of named letters, write L(z) for the set of all finite alpha admitting a complete path from z (including the empty word).

The prescribed local weight of each named letter is u_a in a commutative nonnegative semiring, independent of hidden spectator bits and earlier choices other than their recorded state. The mass of a named word is product(u_a) if its path is legal, and zero otherwise. This covers integer counts and arbitrary fixed nonnegative per-source branch weights; it does not assume that all native BRC weights have this factorization.

## Theorem 987.1 — minimal deterministic future-language carrier

Define z ~ z' iff L(z)=L(z'). Then:

1. The quotient Q=S/~, S=Z/4 x {0,1}^U, is a deterministic partial automaton on the **same named alphabet**. Its transitions are well-defined.
2. For every starting distribution on S, every finite named source word alpha, and every assignment of local nonnegative letter weights u_a, the quotient with aggregated initial class multiplicities gives **exactly** the same path weight. Hence sums of weights over all legal n-step words, including multiplicity and source order, agree for every n>=0.
3. Q is minimal among deterministic quotients of S that preserve legality of **every** future named word. The quotient has at most 4*2^m<=1024 classes; it is computable by exact partition refinement. No assertion of minimality among arbitrary linear, hidden-state, observer-specific or non-deterministic encodings is made.

Proof. If L(z)=L(z'), then for each letter a the paths a and a beta exist simultaneously at z,z'. Thus a is enabled at both or neither; when enabled, the successors have equal right languages, since beta is legal at a successor iff a beta is legal at its predecessor. So ~ is a right congruence and quotient transitions are well-defined. Induction on |alpha| proves exact preservation of each named word's legality. Its weight is the same product of **the same source labels**, proving (2) by summation and aggregation of initial multiplicities. If any deterministic quotient identifies z,z' with different languages, some named alpha is legal at just one of them; that quotient cannot preserve the required future-word observer. Thus every legal quotient refines ~, proving the claimed class minimality. Partition refinement starts with one class (empty word legal at every state), and repeatedly refines by the full vector of enabled named labels and successor classes until stable. The final relation is precisely ~ because a finite deterministic partial automaton has finite-depth distinguishing words for every inequivalent state. QED.

The theorem is **observer-scoped**. Keeping all named words is more informative than merely preserving whether a future path exists. For local weights which additionally depend on an omitted historical quantity, the carrier must be augmented or its fiber-constancy established; no such quotient is asserted here.

## Corollary 987.2 — positive rational generating functions

Fix numeric local weights u_a>=0 and form the nonnegative class adjacency matrix
T_{C,D}=sum_{a:delta(C,a)=D} u_a.
For any initial row vector mu of class multiplicities,
A_n = mu T^n 1
counts the complete n-step weighted named paths, and the ordinary generating series is
F(z)=mu(I-zT)^{-1}1, interpreted formally over the chosen coefficient field.
For rational weights the sequence A_n obeys a rational linear recurrence of order at most |Q| (Cayley-Hamilton).

In the acyclic case of PREFIX-986, every legal path has at most 18 moves, so T^19=0 and F is a polynomial of degree at most 18 for **any** local weights. If the full source automaton has an infinite path and every enabled letter weight is strictly positive, some 8-move return exists by PREFIX-986 and infinitely many coefficients are positive. This last assertion is about **existence from a suitable initial state**, not from an arbitrary prescribed starting state.

For a uniform distribution over all odd p-bit inputs at a fixed initial phase, first compute with each of the 2^m active-bit settings once and multiply by 2^(p-1-m), because the spectator coordinates have that many free assignments. A nonuniform distribution must aggregate its actual class masses instead.

## Exact integer computational certificates

The accompanying independent algorithms build (a) the full active-state graph and (b) its minimal named-right-language quotient, then run integer backward DP on both. Two weight assignments are compared for every n=0..20: u_a=1, and u_a=2 for sign + / 3 for sign -. All table totals below use **one copy per active phase-zero state**; the first case has a factor-two spectator multiplicity when summing all 32 odd six-bit inputs.

| p / word | Active ports | Full states | Exact minimal classes | Phase-zero N_8, unit | Phase-zero N_19, unit | Phase-zero weighted M_8 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 6 / (6,24,6,-3) | 1,2,3,4 | 64 | **57** | 96 | 2,016 | 132,192 |
| 6 / (6,24,8,40) | 1,2,3,4,5 | 128 | **108** | 84 | 0 | 182,736 |
| 4 / (4,-1,3,-7) | 1,2,3 | 32 | **17** | 0 | 0 | 0 |

The first row is a persistent source word; the second realizes the sharp finite 18-move phenomenon of PREFIX-986. For the second row, N_18=12 and N_19=0 on phase-zero active initial states, so the weighted version also vanishes from step 19 on. In the first row the phase-zero unweighted totals start (16,24,36,48,36,72,96,144,96,192,240), and its n=8 weighted total for all 32 odd six-bit starts is 264,384.

Verification files and input:
- research_notes/portable_direct/PREFIX987_R6_WEIGHTED_CARRIER_CHECK.py — standalone Python 3, standard library only; execute with no arguments.
- research_notes/portable_direct/PREFIX987_R6_EXACT_RESULTS.json — exact counts and test coverage.
- Tests use exact integers, not floating point; they do not exhaust all four-residual words at arbitrary widths. The **universal** theorem is the analytic congruence/minimality proof above.

## Future bridge and unresolved questions

The quotient preserves the full future **named-source language and factorized positive letter weights** for this observer. It does not reconstruct original untouched input bits, an arbitrary X6 cell identity, an unmodelled nonlocal BRC weight, or an entire native heartbeat event. Any claimed embedding into the P000 six-axis native space must supply a typed Cell/Link/Port map, a three-dimensional slice selection if applicable, triadic closure semantics, and an explicit observer-preserving lifting theorem; the prefix bit-flip variable is an auxiliary representation, not a native spatial dimension.

Next: evaluate quotient sizes for actual p=19 families; classify which signed-source weights require memory beyond the named-letter carrier; test the source-preserving lift against a concrete current BRC typed operation rather than equating Boolean eight-step return with a native X6 return. The separate mother problem B_fix,odd(32) in {19,20} remains open.
